simple.meaning: עֶצֶם (ʻetsem) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a bone (as strong ); by extension, the body ; figuratively, the substance , i.e. (as pron.) selfsame.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 126 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 2:23. Its contexts include birth, family line, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֶצֶם (H6106).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עֶצֶם (ʻetsem) / H6106 is traced through Genesis 2:23, Genesis 7:13, Genesis 17:23, Genesis 17:26 as a generated source-based concept entry.
